title: Issues when using Nightscout as BG source
symptom: When using Nightscout as BG source with imported AAPS 2 settings, profile activation fails with errors like 'Profile low target 4.8 is out of hard limits' and 'NO PROFILE SET' on Overview. BG data appears on NSClient tab but not on Overview. Issues occur when AAPS is allowed to sync with Nightscout during initial setup.
cause: The thread suggests that profile data synced from Nightscout interferes with the local profile, even after editing, and that AAPS 3.0 automatically enables 'Receive profile store' NSClient setting when importing old settings, which may cause out-of-range profile values to be downloaded.
fix: The issue was mostly resolved in beta 5, but the user suggests that AAPS should not automatically enable 'Receive profile store' when importing settings configured to use a Local Profile. The maintainer explains that new settings are defaulted and such nuances are impossible to process.
evidence_quote: unless I'm misunderstanding things, if a user imports settings configured to use a Local Profile, then AAPS shouldn't automatically enable 'Receive profile store' NSClient setting.
